info.title: apikit-generate-ts-types
info.description: dotnet tool generating TypeScript types and values (error codes, payloads, constant catalogues, enums, request and response types) from an akilin.ApiKit ASP.NET Core app. Personal project — not intended for use by others; no support or stability guarantees.

options.name: --project
options.description: The app's csproj (default: the one in the current directory). Must already be built.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: The app's built entry DLL, instead of --project.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration --project resolves the DLL for (default: the project's default).

options.name: --check
options.description:
Write nothing; fail if the file on disk is missing or differs (for CI).
CRLF line endings and a UTF-8 BOM in the file on disk don't count as differences.
